-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies API keys and connectivity.

file-to-markdown.name: file-to-markdown
file-to-markdown.description: Convert a file to text/Markdown (synchronous). PDFs and Word .docx are extracted locally; scanned PDFs and images are OCR'd locally via @teros/ocr (no API key needed). Use file-to-markdown-async for long-running jobs.

params.inputPath: Path to the file to convert
params.outputPath: Optional output path (defaults to input path with .md extension)
params.chunkSize: Pages per chunk for large PDFs (default: 10). Only used for PDFs >3MB
params.maxRetries: Maximum retries per chunk if processing fails (default: 3)
params.timeout: Timeout in milliseconds per chunk (default: 120000 for chunks, 180000 for direct processing)

file-to-markdown-async.name: file-to-markdown-async
file-to-markdown-async.description: Convert a file to Markdown asynchronously (non-blocking). Supports PDF, Word .docx, and images (png/jpg/tiff/webp/gif/bmp). Returns a job ID immediately. Use get-job-status to check progress.

params.inputPath: Path to the file to convert
params.outputPath: Optional output path (defaults to input path with .md extension)
params.chunkSize: Pages per chunk for large PDFs (default: 10)
params.maxRetries: Maximum retries per chunk if processing fails (default: 3)

get-job-status.name: get-job-status
get-job-status.description: Get the status of an async job. Returns current progress, status, and results when completed.

params.jobId: The job ID returned by file-to-markdown-async

list-jobs.name: list-jobs
list-jobs.description: List all jobs with optional filters. Useful for checking active jobs or recent completions.

params.status: Filter by status: queued, processing, completed, failed, cancelled
params.limit: Maximum number of jobs to return (default: 20)

cancel-job.name: cancel-job
cancel-job.description: Cancel a queued or processing job. Cannot cancel completed/failed jobs.

audio-to-text.name: audio-to-text
audio-to-text.description: Transcribe audio files to text using OpenAI Whisper API. Supports .m4a, .mp3, .wav, .ogg, .webm, .opus and other audio formats.

params.inputPath: Path to the audio file to transcribe
params.language: Optional: Language code (e.g., 'es' for Spanish, 'en' for English). Defaults to 'es' (Spanish) to prevent auto-detection from misidentifying Spanish as Catalan/Galician/Portuguese.

svg-to-png.name: svg-to-png
svg-to-png.description: Convert SVG files to PNG with optional width/height constraints

params.inputPath: Path to the SVG file to convert
params.outputPath: Optional output path (defaults to input path with .png extension)

ocr-extract.name: ocr-extract
ocr-extract.description: Extract text from an image or PDF using local OCR (@teros/ocr — tesseract.js WASM). No API key needed. Returns structured result with per-page confidence scores and low-confidence word markers. Supports: png, jpg, jpeg, tiff, webp, gif, bmp, pdf.

params.inputPath: Path to the image or PDF file
params.pages: Pages to process, e.g. '1-3,5' (default: all). Only for PDFs.

pdf-to-images.name: pdf-to-images
pdf-to-images.description: Show a PDF or image to the agent as images in its context, so it can read it with vision (scans, handwriting, stamps, IDs)

params.inputPath: Path to the PDF or image file
params.pages: PDF pages to show, e.g. '1-3,5' (default: the first 10)
params.maxDimension: Longest side of each image in px (default 1568)
params.autoRotate: Straighten sideways/upside-down pages before attaching them (default true)

name: File Processor
description: Convert files to Markdown with local OCR (PDF, images, DOCX), transcribe audio, convert SVG to PNG

changelog.notes: Local OCR via @teros/ocr (tesseract.js WASM) — scanned PDFs and images are now OCR'd locally without API keys. New ocr-extract tool for structured OCR output with confidence scores. Image support: png, jpg, tiff, webp, gif, bmp.
Initial release — convert documents to Markdown, transcribe audio to text, and turn SVGs into PNG images
